commands.command: cd claude-runner && python -m ruff check src --statistics

import_time.method: python -X importtime, three runs, cumulative microseconds of the last line; wall clock also timed with time.perf_counter
commands: cd claude-runner && python -X importtime -c "import claude_runner" 2>&1 | tail -5
cd claude-runner && python -X importtime -c "import claude_runner.api" 2>&1 | tail -1
cd claude-runner && python -X importtime -c "import claude_runner.board_api" 2>&1 | tail -1
cd claude-runner && python -c "import time; t0=time.perf_counter(); import claude_runner.api; print(round((time.perf_counter()-t0)*1000,1))"

package_import_us.note_variance: the package stub is 1.9-2.4 ms, the four runs differ by machine load
package_import_us.note: the package __init__ is a stub: importing the top-level package costs about 2 ms, everything heavy is in the submodules

import_time.shortcut: import time of the installed copy in the runner venv, not the container's cold start; upgrade by measuring inside the container when a restart is allowed

route_latency_ms.method: in-process fastapi.testclient.TestClient against create_app(Settings.from_env(...)) with an InMemoryBoardStore seeded with 6 missions (1 running, 2 queued, 1 completed, 1 stopped, 1 disabled), 20 requests per route, first request warm-up excluded; dashboard routes measured with create_dashboard_app and httpx.MockTransport. No service was restarted, no provider was contacted (providers_db unset, so provider_registry.start_polling returns None).
route_latency_ms.script: /tmp/baseline/measure.py (scratch, not committed; run with: cd claude-runner && DASHBOARD_BOARD_PG_DSN= python /tmp/baseline/measure.py)
route_latency_ms.shortcut: latency measured against an in-memory board store, not the live Postgres board; upgrade by pointing the same script at a staged DSN when an operator supplies one

requests_per_board_refresh.method: the refresh sequence of src/claude_runner/board_queue.js (BoardQueue: missions + queue, then loadCard per mission = detail + stats, CARD_PARALLEL limits the card fetches), replayed with the store's mission_groups() and counted with a node harness that mirrors the JS calls
commands: cd claude-runner && DASHBOARD_BOARD_PG_DSN= python /tmp/baseline/measure.py (the same sequence replayed through TestClient and counted)

breakdown.card_calls: 2 per mission in the queue (detail + stats): 5 missions in groups x 2 = 10

page_open_breakdown.note: board.html has 37 script tags plus board.css; board.js then adds the 2 list calls and the card calls on top of that

requests_per_board_refresh.not_counted: the offline retry loop (board.js OFFLINE_RETRIES=20 x OFFLINE_DELAY_MS=15000) and the 503 loading retries are re-fetches, not a refresh; they are not counted

not_run.item: end-to-end latency of the live dashboard and board routes over HTTP
not_run.reason: would need the container reachable or recreated; the task forbids restarts and there is no docker in this worker

not_run.item: requests per board refresh in a real browser
not_run.reason: playwright is not installed (python -c "import playwright" -> ModuleNotFoundError), so the network log of a loaded page cannot be captured
not_run.instead: the request sequence is derived from board_queue.js and replayed in python and node

not_run.item: latency against the live Postgres board store
not_run.reason: DASHBOARD_BOARD_PG_DSN points at the production database, which this task must not touch; no DSN was staged by the operator
not_run.instead: InMemoryBoardStore with the same call sequence

not_run.item: provider-related timings (provider registry reload, run launch)
not_run.reason: the task rule says never to measure against providers
